Hand off a staged, verified artifact to the applier.

Returns 202 Accepted once the handoff to the applier is recorded.  Returns
409 Conflict with a machine-readable ``reason`` for a licence, platform, or
container refusal, or when the state store holds no artifact to apply.  In
every refused case, no program file and no file in the staging directory is
changed.
